description: T3.7 check 4: morphed and skinned emissive panels in a lightless room fold their top half through three only (no markChanged); the adapter sends the pose within 2 updates, rays find the folded shape, the floor in front brightens by at least 15%, and with a pose box that reaches the walls GI comes back within 5% when unfolded (the morph with its exact box is a known miss of the mark, reported: see main.ts); recompiles 0.
